Editor-content contract marker: content.html carries data-editor-content="case03-v1.0". That marker identifies the worksheet content contract, not the package version, and has never tracked it; approved releases have shipped with it trailing the package version before. It is deliberately not re-stamped at this release: the marker is not printable, and rewriting it would alter the content.html digest that the accepted visual-modernization records certify as unchanged. Recorded here rather than corrected in place.
